title: Chapter 109 — Promotions and Floor Execution
intro: Promo mechanics, event execution, and compliance.

sections.title: Know the Promo Before the Customer Does
sections.content:
When a promotion launches, you should know the details before the first customer asks. Which products are included? What are the terms? What is the financing offer? When does it end?

Promotional periods generate higher traffic. The salespeople who are prepared capture more of that traffic. The ones who are learning the promo on the fly waste opportunities.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating promotional execution, ask:

Is the salesperson prepared before each promotional period — or scrambling on day one?
Do they know the terms, inclusions, and exclusions?
Are they using promotions to create urgency honestly — or making claims they cannot support?
